For this challenge the instructions were to Login to the Administrator account as shown on the description on the image above:
Now I had done two more other challenges with the same methodologies that is:
__Login Jim__ and __Login Bender__ 
Now to login to the administrators account we need to navigate to the accounts menu to access the login field

![Juice-Shop-Challenges/Login Admin 20261019-131941.png](data:image/png;base64,)

From the Login Fields above,we need to have the Admin's email and Password.
Since this is an Injection challenge so if we can get the email we can do a basic SQLI injection without the need of a password
I tried to randomly guess the email and using the password `12345` with an appended injection attack and got an error `401 unauthorized` 
This basically means that the web request failed due to invalid credentials so the Web -server cannot authorize and authenticate the client

![Juice-Shop-Challenges/Login Admin 20261019-133308.png](data:image/png;base64,)

From the burp request and respass above we can see the random email I used with the SQLI injection query appended at the end as `admin@mail.com' or '1'='1` 
Now I realized that for any of my payloads to work I'll need to have atleast one value for this challenge.
I went back to the juice shop and began browsing the different flavours and I realized something especially on the reviews.
When a user left a review the shop leaked their email in plaintext,from here I began hunting for the admins email:

![Juice-Shop-Challenges/Login Admin 20261019-134233.png](data:image/png;base64,)

From here I tried to login again with the email and the same payload now refined as:
`admin@juice-sh.op' or '1'='1`
